messages:
elaine_sales: Sharing the updated HeliosHealth RFP — main asks on landing-zone requirements, secure peering, KMS/HSM options, and PoC duration. PDF + questionnaire attached: https://s3.redwood.internal/helios/helios-rfp-2026.pdf

mike_solutions: Got it. Quick checklist: do they require cross-account VPC peering or just VPC endpoint/VPN? Helios mentioned ‘landing zone with audit controls’ in Q12.

julian_se: They indicated cross-account peering + centralized logging to their Splunk. Also asked whether Redwood can be deployed inside their VPC (private deployment) or if Hosted with VPC peering is acceptable.

anya_sec: Security notes — we need to answer:
```
- KMS integration: customer-managed keys (BYOK) supported? (Y/N)
- HSM-backed keys for signing? (Y/N)
- Audit log retention & export (S3/Splunk) path
- SOC2 / FedRAMP status + any gaps
```
I can draft written answers but need infra confirmation on BYOK/HSM.

frank_infra: BYOK: yes for Private deployments (KMS/HSM through customer KMS via VPC endpoints). Hosted API: we offer envelope encryption but not customer-managed HSM today. Can we mark Hosted as "BYOK via Dedicated/Private only" in the matrix?

mike_solutions: Yes mark it like that. For RFP matrix we should include a small compatibility table. Quick sample to copy into the spreadsheet: 
```
Feature,Hosted API,Dedicated,Private(VPC)
BYOK (KMS),Limited,Yes,Yes
HSM-backed keys,No,Partial (partner HSM),Yes
VPC peering,No,Yes,Yes
Audit log export,Yes,Yes,Yes
SLA,Standard,Premium,Enterprise
```

elaine_sales: Perfect. Also Helios asked about PoC: they want 5k concurrent requests simulation and 6-week PoC with data-in-region requirement (eu-west-1). Pricing Q: do we need a reserved capacity commitment for that scale during PoC?

frank_infra: For predictable perf at 5k concurrent we recommend Dedicated reserved pool. For a 6-week PoC we can offer a short-term reserved commit (monthly) or use burstable Dedicated with surge pricing. Ops: will need a pre-prod cluster in eu-west-1 and a traffic test plan.

anya_sec: Compliance/contract ask: Helios wants a data residency clause + encryption in transit and at rest. They've included a regulatory appendix that references GDPR processors. We'll answer with our standard GDPR addendum and call out where Private gives full isolation.

julian_se: I'll capture the written RFP responses. Elaine — can you confirm the PoC acceptance criteria? Helios listed: max tail latency <= 250ms p95, 99.9% availability during tests, and no model output leakage on previous customers' data.

elaine_sales: Confirming those acceptance criteria. Also they want a short list of deliverables: test plan, support rotation, onboarding runbook, and a run-of-show. I attached our recommended POC checklist here: https://drive.redwood/poctemplates/landing-zone-poc-checklist.pdf

mike_solutions: Draft answer for the questionnaire section Q5 (networking):
"Redwood supports private deployment in customer VPCs using our Private agent that establishes outbound-only control plane connections. For Dedicated we support VPC peering and transit gateway integrations; hosted customers can use secure API endpoints with optional VPC endpoints for egress controls. Audit logs can be exported to customer S3 or pushed to Splunk via our logging connector"

anya_sec: +1. For HSM we should add: "HSM-backed key management is available for Private deployments; for Dedicated engagements we can evaluate partner HSM options during contract."

deploy-bot: build-notice: rfp-packager v2.3 started assembling attachments (capability_matrix.csv, poc_template.pdf, security_appendix.docx). ETA 45s. :package:

frank_infra: Action items: @anya_sec to finalize security appendix answers; @mike_solutions to produce the capability matrix CSV; @julian_se to draft PoC SOW; @elaine_sales to send commercial ask (preferred billing model for PoC).

elaine_sales: I'll send the PoC pricing ask — leaning to a 2-month committed Dedicated trial at discounted rate. Will post pricing numbers in this thread once finance confirms.

mike_solutions: I'll drop the CSV into the shared folder when ready. Will include explicit text snippets for RFP copy-paste.

anya_sec: I'll aim to get the security appendix back by EOD tomorrow. If we need legal sign-off on the GDPR addendum will ping @legal.

elaine_sales: Thanks team — Helios deadline is COB Friday. If we hit snags, I'll escalate. :pray:
